capture_design.expected_crop_policy: Control poses show the complete airplane; close material sweep frames explicitly declare expected_crop=true.
capture_design.frame_elapsed_scope: Host-side wall interval through frame_post_draw; reported as a diagnostic, not a GPU benchmark.
capture_design.motion_policy: Each pose is applied directly from a fixed command sample; there is no real-time animation or simulation clock.
